description: This file defines the internal server setup for the AgentField control plane, including server initialization, route setup, health checks, gRPC server management, and integration with various services such as DID, VC, health monitoring, and UI handling.

classes.name: AgentFieldServer
classes.description: Main server class managing initialization, route setup, health checks, gRPC server, and service integrations.

methods.name: NewAgentFieldServer
methods.description: Constructs and initializes a new AgentFieldServer instance with configuration, services, and route setup.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the server, including route setup, background services, health checks, and gRPC server.

methods.name: startAdminGRPCServer
methods.description: Initializes and runs the admin gRPC server with optional API key middleware.

methods.name: ListReasoners
methods.description: Handles gRPC request to list registered reasoners across agent nodes.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server, stopping gRPC, health checks, background services, and cleanup.

methods.name: unregisterAgentFromMonitoring
methods.description: Removes an agent from health monitoring based on node ID.

methods.name: healthCheckHandler
methods.description: Provides a comprehensive health status report including storage and cache health.

methods.name: setupRoutes
methods.description: Configures all HTTP routes, middleware, static file serving, API endpoints, and SPA fallback.

methods.name: generateAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Creates a deterministic server ID based on the agentfield home directory path.
